title: VCMI cursor format
description: One cursor, as declared in a file listed under 'cursors' in the mod manifest

image.description: image to use for this cursor. Overrides 'animation'

animation.description: animation to take this cursor from. Requires 'frame' or 'animated'

frame.description: index of the frame inside the animation to use for this cursor

animated.description: when true the cursor is animated using the entire animation file

pivotX.description: horizontal position inside the image acting as the pointer tip, which is the pixel a click is reported at

pivotY.description: vertical position inside the image acting as the pointer tip
